Your dreams stay on this phone: no account, no internet, no tracking. Telling a dream aloud uses your phone’s own speech recognition.
In a dream, the top never falls
Spintop teaches you to notice, inside a dream, that you’re dreaming. You don’t need talent for that, only a habit you can learn.
A few times a day, a quiet “Are you dreaming?”. In the morning, tell your dream; the app finds your dream signs. At night, two minutes with the top and an intention.
The more you practise, the longer it spins. Each lucid dream adds a brass ring, and the morning after one, the top doesn’t fall all day.
